name: TitleIgnites
camera: Static camera; the framing stays fixed on the title lettering.
audio: a single deep drum hit, a rising shimmer and a low dragon's breath; no speech
subject: The first frame shows the game title "SOVEREIGN TERRITORIES" in large carved obsidian letters with a tagline in gold beneath, on a dark misty background.
world: Dark mist drifts slowly behind the lettering, embers float upward and a faint dawn glow gathers at the horizon of the frame.
constraints: Keep the title lettering, spelling and layout exactly as in the first frame; no new text, no cuts, smooth natural motion, no people.

actions.beat: Embers gather and drift toward the lettering as the mist parts.
The carved obsidian letters ignite from within with molten gold, a wave of dawn light sweeping across them from left to right.
The glow settles into a steady shimmer and the tagline brightens beneath the title.

notes: Title-screen sting and reel opener. Feed the rendered title lockup as the source image.
